steps.en: Failed or impossible electronic sending is detected
steps.id: Pengiriman elektronik yang gagal atau mustahil terdeteksi

steps.en: Notice is moved to the letter track as an AN
steps.id: Notice dipindah ke jalur surat tetap sebagai AN

steps.en: Latest-address check picks up the AN notice
steps.id: Cek alamat terbaru memilih notice AN
steps.why_en: Only NRIC owners are covered; FIN, company and passport owners are not.
steps.why_id: Hanya owner NRIC yang tercakup; owner FIN, company, dan passport tidak.

steps.en: Latest address is saved on the owner record
steps.id: Alamat terbaru disimpan di data owner
steps.why_en: Address updates have open or recent defects around timestamps and result files.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan alamat masih punya cacat terkait cap waktu dan file hasil.

steps.en: Latest address is used for the AN letter
steps.id: Alamat terbaru dipakai untuk surat AN
steps.why_en: A notice without an address is dropped quietly and never flagged to staff.
steps.why_id: Notice tanpa alamat dibuang diam-diam dan tidak ditandai ke staf.
